name: Source control
description: Branch status, diffs, staging, commits, remote operations, history and conflicts for a worktree.

method.description: A worktree's branch, upstream, changed files by section, the operation in progress and the running remote call.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

branch.description: Current branch name, or null when detached or unborn without a name.

upstream.description: Upstream as git names it (origin/main), or null.

files.description: v1 file list: one row per path with index and worktree letters.

head.description: HEAD commit sha, or null on an unborn branch.

detached.description: HEAD points at a commit, not a branch.

unborn.description: The branch has no commits yet.

entries.description: One row per change, with area, status, line counts and conflict kind; conflicts first.

path.description: Path relative to the worktree root.

oldPath.description: Previous path of a renamed or copied file.

state.description: unresolved, or resolved_locally once git stopped listing it but it was opened for this operation.

added.description: Added lines; absent when unknown or the status is capped.

removed.description: Removed lines; absent when unknown or the status is capped.

commitChanged.description: The submodule points at another commit.

operation.description: Merge, rebase or cherry-pick in progress, else none.

capped.description: True when the status stopped at 1,000 entries.

hasUpstream.description: The branch has an effective upstream.

behindPatchEquivalent.description: True when every commit behind the upstream is a patch-equivalent copy of a local one; null when unknown.

busy.description: The locked operation running in this worktree (push, force-push, pull, fast-forward, fetch, sync, rebase, continue, abort), or null.

method.description: Both sides of a file diff for a source; staged is HEAD against the index, unstaged the index against the working file.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

path.description: File path relative to the worktree root.

source.description: Which sides to read; defaults to staged when `staged` is set, else unstaged.

oldPath.description: Previous path of a renamed file.

mergeBase.description: Merge base commit for source branch (40 hex).

head.description: Head commit for source branch (40 hex).

parent.description: Parent commit for source commit (40 hex); omit for a root commit.

original.description: The left side's text; empty for binary, image and too-large files.

modified.description: The right side's text; empty for binary, image and too-large files.

oldPath.description: Previous path of a renamed file.

mime.description: Mime type of an image; original and modified are then base64.

modifiedHash.description: sha-256 of the working file for an unstaged diff; null when the file is missing.

method.description: Stages files by path, or every change with scope. A submodule root and a conflict that still has markers are refused.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

paths.description: Paths relative to the worktree root; give this or scope.

scope.description: all stages everything including untracked files; tracked only modified and deleted tracked files. Give this or paths.

method.description: Unstages files; a staged rename is reset on both its new and old path.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

paths.description: Paths relative to the worktree root.

method.description: Throws away working-tree changes: reverts tracked files to the index, deletes untracked ones. Staged changes are unstaged first when area is staged. Cannot be undone.

worktree.description: Worktree selector (id, name, branch, path: or current); defaults to the caller's worktree.

paths.description: Paths relative to the worktree root; give this or area.

area.description: Discard every row of a section; give this or paths.

method.description: The question asked before a discard.

paths.description: Paths relative to the worktree root; give this or area.

area.description: Discard every row of a section; give this or paths.

method.description: Commits the staged changes. A failing hook is reported with a summary and its output.

message.description: The commit message; blank is refused.

setting.title: Source Control Group Order
setting.description: Which section comes first after Conflicts.

setting.description: What the branch compare uses when the worktree has no base of its own.

setting.description: Show changed files as a list or grouped by folder.

setting.description: Highlight whitespace-only changes and trailing whitespace in diffs.
